oracle.basis: Indexed and unindexed identical predicate on the same loaded zero must agree. Post-source probe verifies INSERT IGNORE materialized exactly one zero. Do not classify warning alone.
oracle.allowed_warning_note: INSERT IGNORE conversion warning and DELAYED ignored notice expected.
oracle.phase_rule: Execute original SQL unchanged and in order, then separately captured read-only validation SQL; validation is required before classification.
oracle.on_sql_error: These selected reports target wrong results, not SQL errors; unexpected SQL errors mean execution_failed, never automatically reproduced.
oracle.on_other_pattern: other_anomaly; do not attribute an unexpected pattern to the report
oracle.duplicate_note: c530389 identifies duplicate of #110209; do not count independent root cause.

target_saved_classification_reason: Exact reported wrong-result pattern and all required same-session controls match

comparison_rules.normal: Indexed and after-drop-index LEAST predicates each return stored decimal zero.
comparison_rules.same_target_anomaly: Indexed predicate empty, no-index predicate returns zero.
comparison_rules.case_gates: INSERT IGNORE conversion to0 intentional; postcheck count1 min=max0; preserve control-character SQL bytes.
comparison_rules.unknown: Syntax/unsupported feature errors, failed setup/postcheck, timeouts/OOM/connection errors, mismatching environment, uncomparable plan or any other unexplained result are unknown; never normal.
comparison_rules.conclusion: Previous normal plus validated target abnormal => observed_new_at_release; same anomaly on previous => pre_existing; otherwise unknown.

execution_contract.clean_state: Fresh isolated container/schema and client session; schema UTF8MB4 with utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci; preserve exact source and postcheck bytes. Destroy dedicated schema/container after evidence capture.
execution_contract.environment: Compare recorded target variables and preflight; source session changes intentional and must be reproduced. No plugin, build, host setting or source edits authorized by this review.
execution_contract.mysql_client: utf8mb4, batch/raw/verbose/show-warnings; force only #110181 expected-error contract; complete postcheck.
